name: Oxbow
author: hundekraft
description: Two oscillators with sync and cross-modulation into a state-variable filter, an internal filter envelope and a little vintage drift per voice. It comes from OberVave, zvenson's polysynth for the M-VAVE FM-1. Each encoder is a macro that moves several of these at once, so every position is a usable sound. Save and recall sounds with the normal OP-1 presets.
